notes: THE OUTFIT · Sisters Wyrd's half of the shared StickLoop contract.
EARN: silver you rode home with, plus 4 per sister dealt with,
plus 6 for reaching the loom. SPEND: this list, from the shelf's
OUTFIT screen. CARRY: WyrdHexcrawl reads effects[] at boot and
The rule from the playbook: every tier carries at least one FLAG,
not just numbers. A flag opens a verb or a route — that is the
difference between customization and a stat treadmill. Tier 1 has
warm_coat / dead_reckoning, tier 2 has notice_pocket / hard_ride,
Fiction check (per the aesthetic bible): all nine are things a
1993 rider could put in a saddlebag. Nothing here is a stat card.

currency.name: SILVER
currency.earn_line: silver you rode home with · sisters dealt pay 4 each · the loom pays 6

upgrades.name: THE LONG COAT
upgrades.blurb: oilcloth to the boot-top. the first cold that would have taken its cut each ride doesn't.

upgrades.name: THE SECOND CANTEEN
upgrades.blurb: water for two, carried by one. the dry country asks less often.

upgrades.name: THE BRASS COMPASS
upgrades.blurb: eight points, four of them labelled. the east sister can make the light lie; she cannot make brass lie.

upgrades.name: THE DOG-EARED PAPERBACK
upgrades.blurb: somebody's copy, read to pieces. you start the ride already knowing one thing.

upgrades.name: THE INSIDE POCKET
upgrades.blurb: deep enough for two notices. the boards start describing you to each other.

upgrades.name: A BETTER HORSE
upgrades.blurb: she has one hard ride in her per day, and she knows which day.

upgrades.name: CREDIT AT THE BOARDS
upgrades.blurb: five townships, one name in five ledgers. you may run two silver under, once per ride.

upgrades.name: THE MOURNING VEIL
upgrades.blurb: black crepe, borrowed. a town wearing black for a sister you DREW stops charging you for its grief.

upgrades.name: THE EIGHTH POINT
upgrades.blurb: you have crossed the shimmer once and remembered it. now the edge lets you through without the third push.
